response.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) as overall_avg_bw FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL), station_avg AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) as station_avg_bw FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), above_average_stations AS (SELECT sa.station_avg_bw, oa.overall_avg_bw, (sa.station_avg_bw - oa.overall_avg_bw) as difference_above_avg FROM station_avg sa CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE sa.station_avg_bw > oa.overall_avg_bw) SELECT AVG(station_avg_bw) as mean_bandwidth_usage, AVG(difference_above_avg) as avg_distance_above_average FROM above_average_stations
